claim_en: The ornaments stripped from Mount Chorev — the spine identifies the Sinai crowns of the two-angels tradition, Buber the Name-engraved armor; stripped unwillingly; the one-hour destruction rationale carried on the Presence-layer (Onkelos Exod 33): the we-will-do-and-hear grant revoked at the calf.

The tent renamed BET ULPANA — and every SEEKER OF INSTRUCTION from before the LORD goes out to it: seeking God decoded as seeking teaching, the interim interface a school open to everyone (Onkelos Exod 33) — against the priestly oracle's access list (EX28-09): two interfaces, two authorization models. The mile, the elder-as-Presence law, and the excommunication a-fortiori ride.

source: Onkelos on Exod 33:9-11; the protocol at Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 27
claim_en: Face-to-face rendered SPEECH WITH SPEECH, as a man with his friend — the reflexive form guarding transcendence; Joshua the resident student; and the spine's protocol: when I am angry you appease, when you are angry I appease — BOTH faces must not be angry at once — with the return-to-camp command and the Joshua-replacement warning (Onkelos Exod 33; Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 27).

source: Onkelos on Exod 33:12-17; the timing law at Pirkei Avot 4:18
claim_en: The favor negotiation runs on the by-name exaltation verb (Bezalel's own, 31:2) and the Presence-layer; the distinction effected by WONDERS; and the case shelf reads the clause as the appeasement-timing law — do not placate in the hour of anger; wait until the face of anger passes (Pirkei Avot 4:18, this exam's docket; Onkelos Exod 33).

source: Onkelos on Exod 33:18-23; the treasuries at Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 27
claim_en: No man sees the FACE of My Presence and lives; a place PREPARED BEFORE ME — My place secondary to Me; the cave; I will shield you WITH MY WORD; that-which-is-behind-Me seen, that-which-is-before-Me not (Onkelos Exod 33). The treasuries ride: the reward-stores and the GRATIS store — grace beyond merit standing stock; the wicked's-ease question deferred to the world to come (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 27).
